text:
Alex (SRE): Morning — quick async standup. What I did: validated canary of kv-cache eviction fix on prod pool, rolled back 2 small kernel changes. Blockers: still seeing 95p latency bump on /generate when seq >1024; looking at kernel selection thresholds. Today: follow up with infra, add test for long-seq, and open PR for dynamic batch cap. @Katie can you eyeball p-lon-1 storage IOPS? :eyes:

Maria (SRE): Saw the same 95p bump in the telemetry. I ran a quick heap profile on the serving runtime and dropped the flame graph in #eng-runtime. No blockers for me, will review Alex's PR later today.

Jon (SRE): Oncall notes: two pages overnight — transient kv-eviction alert (fixed by service restart) and an external ratelimit causing elevated 5xx from a downstream service. I added a temporary suppression for the kv eviction flapping for 4h. Regarding SLOs: token-loss error budget at ~92% remaining (so still okay) but latency budget creeping. Recommend avoiding risky infra work until EOD.

Alex (SRE): Thanks @Jon — ack. Won't push autoscaler or kernel changes during business hours.

Katie (Platform): @Alex pulling IOPS now. Also putting a 15m sync on my calendar at 11:30 in case we want a quick call.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T10:05 by deployer_k: rollout started for commit abc123 to redwood-serving-prod (canary 5%).

Maria (SRE): Quick ask — can someone ping @eng-ml about model quantization fallback? We've seen a slight increase in token error for ~25% of requests since the canary.

Alex (SRE): Pinged eng-ml in thread. Opened PR #4521: dynamic-batch-cap with fallback. Link: https://git.example/rdw/pr/4521

Jon (SRE): I'll review — please add a unit/integration test that simulates seq lengths >2048 and a perf profile check.

Alex (SRE): Will add both today.

Katie (Platform): IOPS check: nominal, small spike at 09:45 but well within thresholds, no sustained degradation.

Maria (SRE): Sounds good. I'll drop the kv suppression once canary is stable for 1h.

Alex (SRE): Will update here in ~2h with canary status. :thumbsup:
